caption: Aerial view of sheep penned in fenced enclosures at the Lairg sheep auction, Scotland.

Lusaka, Zambia Supporters of president-elect, Hakainde Hichilema, celebrate his reelection for a second term. The 64-year-old, credited with restructuring the country’s debt and making schooling free, won with around 60% of the vote.

Jakarta, Indonesia University students jostle with police officers during a protest against government policies, including state budget spending, the free meals programme and expanded military roles in civilian affairs.
Cambridge, England Floral tributes to the late Cambridge professor Jason Arday are left outside Senate House after his death at age 41.
Waimes, Belgium Firefighters attend a wildfire in Waimes, in the Hautes Fagnes region.

Moscow, Russia Japan’s ambassador to Russia, Akira Muto, leaves the Russian foreign ministry after a tit-for-tat summoning by Tokyo and Moscow, sparked by Putin’s visit to Iturup, a disputed island known in Japan as Etorofu.

Kyiv, Ukraine An honour guard holds a portrait of Col Yevhen Konovalets beside his grave during a reburial ceremony at the national military memorial cemetery. Konovalets, a military commander and leader of the Ukrainian nationalist movement, was assassinated in Rotterdam in 1938. His remains have been repatriated from the Netherlands after 88 years.

Washington DC, US The renovated Arts of War statues, newly covered in gold leaf, at Arlington Memorial Bridge near the Lincoln Memorial. The Trump administration has ordered a $5.1m restoration project to regild the two Arts of War statues, along with the nearby Arts of Peace companion statues. The four statues are being restored under a project overseen by the US Department of the Interior.
Auckland, New Zealand A look card backstage ahead of the twenty-seven names show at New Zealand fashion week.
London, England Artist Clare Twomey at the press preview of the War Child x Secret 7” exhibition at 180 Studios, where 700 sleeves will be auctioned to raise money for children affected by war.
Shanghai, China Tourists visit a giant 13-metre-long dachshund installation at the Haus Nowhere store on Huaihai Middle Road.
A boy walks across a white marble-waste dumping yard with turquoise pools visible behind him.
Pannonhalma, Hungary A person prays inside the historic basilica of the Pannonhalma Archabbey, one of Hungary’s oldest religious and cultural landmarks and a Unesco world heritage site.
Pereira, Colombia A girl plays with a kitten at a provisional shelter after a 7.4 earthquake in which at least 287 people have died.

Nairobi, Kenya A Kenyan police officer detains activist Julius Kamau as he participates in a protest demanding the immediate resignation of the inspector general of police, Douglas Kanja, outside his office.

Akre, Iraq Ninety couples sit in rows during a mass wedding ceremony organised on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the founding of the Kurdistan Democratic party (KDP) in the town of Akre, about 60 miles north of Erbil, the capital of Iraq’s autonomous northern Kurdish region.
Kanal ob Soči, Slovenia A participant jumps into the Soča River from a 17-metre-high bridge during a traditional jumping event.
California, US Al Green performs at the Stern Grove festival in San Francisco.
Manila, Philippines People wade through flood waters during heavy monsoon rains.
Gaza City, Palestine A salvage worker scraps steel from the rubble of a building that was destroyed during Israel’s war against Hamas.
La Paz, Bolivia A dog receives a blessing of holy water during a mass celebrating Saint Roch’s Day.
Rajasthan, India A young boy walks on mounds of marble dust at the marble-waste dumping yard in Kishangarh.
Wales, UK Mourners read the order of service during the funeral of Bonnie Tyler at Swansea Minster. The singer who was born Gaynor Hopkins, died in hospital on 8 July, aged 75, in Portugal.
Kyiv, Ukraine Bookseller Alexander Bahlai reacts as firefighters try to put out a fire at a city book market after a Russian missile attack.
Ohio, US A praying mantis pictured at the Grandstand court during Sunday’s second round of the Cincinnati Open at the Lindner Family Tennis Center, Mason.
East Nusa Tenggara province, Indonesia Children observe the damage at the St Fransiskus Asisi-Karot church, in the aftermath of an earthquake, in Ruteng, Manggarai regency.

West Bank, Israel Israeli settlers stand on the doorstep of a house after the reopening of a settlement at Ganim in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. The settlement was dismantled more than 20 years ago as part of a disengagement plan by the then government, which wanted to reduce friction by leaving densely populated Palestinian areas. Benjamin Netanyahu’s government gave the green light to rebuild the settlement.
Bellanwila, Sri Lanka Performers take part in the Pandam Paliya performance during the final Grand Randoli Perahera of the 76th Bellanwila Esala festival.

Kabul, Afghanistan A boy holds an AK-style rifle while sitting in a vehicle decorated with Taliban flags during celebrations marking the fifth anniversary of the US withdrawal from Afghanistan and the Taliban’s return to power.
Istanbul, Turkey Residents cool off in the Bosphorus as summer temperatures remain high.

Jakarta, Indonesia Participants attend the greasy pole climbing race locally known as Panjat Pinang to collect prizes hung at the top during celebrations to mark the 81st independence day celebrations.
People take pictures of Madonna's face on a large screen at the installation.

Sremska Mitrovica, Serbia The wreckage of the Slovenac, a paddle-wheel tugboat built in 1913, emerging from the low waters of the Sava River as drought and prolonged hot and dry weather lowered water levels across the region. The Slovenac sank on 25 April 1945 after striking a German mine while transporting supplies and wounded soldiers in the final days of the second world war.

Maumere, Indonesia People evacuated because of a magnitude-7.7 earthquake are placed in temporary shelters in East Nusa Tenggara province. According to the national search and rescue agency of Indonesia, at least 51 people died as a result of the earthquake.
London, UK Felipe Drugovich of Brazil driving the Andretti Formula E Porsche 99X Electric during a practice session at the London E-Prix.
Navarra, Spain Runners, or mozos, are chased by the bulls of Pedro Dominguez’s ranch in the Pilon de Falces bull run.
Kyiv, Ukraine Firefighters at the site of a book market hit by a Russian missile strike.
Podolsk, Russia People watch as smoke rises above a warehouse belonging to the online retailer Wildberries after a reported Ukrainian drone strike at the Koledino industrial park near Moscow.
Treorchy, UK The view from Bute Street in Treorchy as a wildfire blazes through the Ynysfeio forest in south Wales in the early hours of Sunday morning.
Hampshire, UK The Boomtown festival illuminates the South Downs national park at Cheesefoot Head near Winchester. This year’s festival has been hit by dust problems due to the heatwave.
San Sebastián, Spain The 61st international fireworks contest of the Semana Grande.
Birmingham, UK The British men’s and women’s 4 x 100m relay gold medalists at the European Athletics Championships.
Tarusa, Russia Horses and drivers compete in a harness race during an annual festival honouring the Orlov Trotter breed in the Kaluga region.
Budapest, Hungary A Russian athlete performs during the team acrobatic final of the World Aquatics Junior Artistic Swimming Championships.
Brooklyn, New York Coney Island beach on the shore of the Atlantic Ocean. The beaches will soon close to swimmers as autumn approaches in New York and lifeguard cover ends.
Paredes de Coura, Portugal A crowd enjoys MEUTE’s surprise afternoon performance at the River Coura during the final day of the Paredes de Coura festival.
Mannenbach, Switzerland A floating jetty and boats stranded on the dried-up shores of the Untersee during the heatwave.
Bugac, Hungary Horse riders in costume on the second day of the Great Hun-Turkic Kurultaj event, which brings together communities of Hun and Turkic descent to celebrate their heritage.

Quibdó, Colombia People on motorcycles pass in front of a destroyed building in the Medrano neighbourhood after a 7.4-magnitude earthquake. At least 287 people have died, thousands have been injured and about 379 remain unaccounted for.
Berlin, Germany Participants in the Rave the Planet techno parade walk through the streets of Berlin.
Fnideq, Morocco A member of Moroccan security stands guard as people gather on a hill to try to cross to the Spanish city of Ceuta.
Kabul, Afghanistan Taliban security personnel dance with a rocket-propelled grenade during celebrations to mark the fifth anniversary of their return to power.

Düren, Germany A helicopter drops water on to the Hürtgenwald forest fire. Authorities evacuated 2,000 people from the district of Gey as the blaze consumed more than 200 hectares (494 acres) of land, making it the biggest wildfire ever in the state of North Rhine-Westphalia.

Ningbo, China The Dubai Tower container ship, operated by the Chinese shipowner Sea Legend, setting sail from Ningbo heading to Felixstowe in the UK. The ship owner began the first weekly container service through the Arctic on an express route to Europe on 15 August, planning to make the voyages until October and prompting concerns over vessels warming polar ice.
Kent, UK Activists from Stand Up to Racism assemble outside County Hall in Maidstone to counter-protest against the far-right Kent Nationalist Movement.
Cornwall, UK Andy Burnham sees potatoes being sorted during a visit to Colwyn Farm near Truro.
Dorset, UK Members of the Royal Southern yacht club and the Island sailing club take part in the annual Brambles cricket match on the Bramble Bank sandbank in the middle of the Solent at low tide.
Berkshire, UK Spectators sit on benches on the grass scorched by the recent heatwaves at Newbury racecourse.
